latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor for Captions — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: auto-generates and burns in captions to uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Supports multi-language captions with auto-sync (e.g. English and Spanish).
- Cloud-based pipeline: handles upload, editing, captioning, and 1080p MP4 export without local installation.
- Interactive workflow: upload clips, give editing instructions via chat, and download captioned videos within ~30–90 seconds.
- Tracks credits and session status automatically; provides clear error handling for authentication, file type, and export issues.
